name: Monochrome archive collage with one accent

source.description: An inspected brand film cuts between black-and-white archival imagery (engravings, photographs, sculpture) with thin construction lines, serif words and a single accent colour.

technique: Public-domain monochrome imagery on white, overlaid with analytic line drawings and one accent mark, gives a thoughtful, museum-like tone; fast cuts between images on the beat keep it lively.
purpose: Editorial, reflective or 'ideas' pieces; intellectual tone without stock-photo look.
visual_behaviour: B/W cut-outs on white; a spiral or guide line traces over an image; serif words appear; a single accent element punctuates.
mechanics: Hard cuts about every 0.75 s; line overlays drawn with a pen-led stroke; images cut out with clean edges.

decomposition.timing: Image cuts about 0.5-1 s; type holds about 1-2 s.

failure_modes: Reproducing a specific brand's combination of archive imagery, serif and accent colour reproduces its identity
Using images without public-domain or licence verification

implementation.approach: Source images through the collage-design skill (Openverse/Wikimedia public domain with attribution); cut-outs as image layers; Studio.draw.pen for construction lines; one accent token.

additional_tooling.justification: collage-design skill already covers sourcing and cut-outs

provenance.observed: Snowflake photographs, motion-study photographs, engravings and sculpture cut-outs in black and white with thin accent line work.

licensing_notes: Technique only. The reference is a brand film whose identity (mark, accent colour, serif, archive look as a whole) must not be reproduced; its specific image treatments are not reused.
